{
  "dataset_name": "advanced_iot_dataset",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gpt-5.5-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "chlorophyll_z_clipped",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Clipped z-score of plant chlorophyll using fixed training-fold mean and standard deviation.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized_physiology",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a centered greenness axis on a scale suited to linear margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((`Average  of chlorophyll in the plant (ACHP)` - 38.069000880404516) / 4.444221059174895, -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "shoot_growth_projection_z",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted clipped z-score of height, leaf area, and leaf count as a shoot size projection.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "linear_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Condenses coordinated shoot expansion into one smooth feature, reducing coefficient burden for correlated measurements.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((0.40 * ((`Plant height rate (PHR)` - 58.996031108641645) / 11.997943803474543)) + (0.35 * ((`Average leaf area of the plant (ALAP)` - 1063.9913408531997) / 260.435423111957)) + (0.25 * ((`Average number of plant leaves (ANPL)` - 3.940832253016659) / 0.699902093550082)), -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "leaf_area_per_leaf_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Clipped 0-to-1 score for leaf area per leaf.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures canopy expansion per leaf rather than total leaf count alone, giving a compact ratio for the linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(((`Average leaf area of the plant (ALAP)` / (`Average number of plant leaves (ANPL)` + 0.001)) - 130.0) / (591.0 - 130.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "vegetative_biomass_projection_z",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted clipped z-score of vegetative wet mass and vegetative dry mass.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "linear_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Combines related above-ground biomass signals into a single normalized axis useful for stable linear weighting.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((0.55 * ((`Average wet weight of the growth vegetative (AWWGV)` - 1.2481952302564823) / 0.24667278291811653)) + (0.45 * ((`Average dry weight of vegetative plants (ADWV)` - 0.2929089353828336) / 0.15300660836690713)), -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "root_structure_projection_z",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted clipped z-score of root diameter and root length.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "linear_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Summarizes root architecture in a smooth continuous dimension that can complement biomass features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((0.55 * ((`Average root diameter (ARD)` - 16.294387881633487) / 2.8699437244160153)) + (0.45 * ((`Average root length (ARL)` - 18.06528163339825) / 2.9213830829499745)), -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "root_biomass_projection_z",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Balanced clipped z-score projection of root wet mass and root dry mass.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "linear_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a normalized root mass axis, helping the model compare below-ground growth with above-ground growth.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((0.50 * ((`Average wet weight of the root (AWWR)` - 2.907887952448599) / 1.3550773555371625)) + (0.50 * ((`Average dry weight of the root (ADWR)` - 1.0004772176564658) / 0.45452730022704296)), -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "dry_matter_projection_z",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Balanced clipped z-score projection of vegetative and root dry-matter percentages.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized_physiology",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a continuous tissue-composition axis that is less redundant with raw wet and dry weights.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((0.50 * ((`Percentage of dry matter for vegetative growth (PDMVG)` - 22.712011370631444) / 9.630180109708622)) + (0.50 * ((`Percentage of dry matter for root growth (PDMRG)` - 34.90611134489562) / 8.041797246601849)), -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "wet_root_to_shoot_ratio_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Clipped 0-to-1 score for wet root mass relative to vegetative wet mass.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Represents allocation between root and shoot wet biomass as a bounded continuous measure.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(((`Average wet weight of the root (AWWR)` / (`Average wet weight of the growth vegetative (AWWGV)` + 0.001)) - 0.63) / (8.14 - 0.63), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "dry_root_to_shoot_ratio_log_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-compressed clipped 0-to-1 score for dry root mass relative to vegetative dry mass.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Uses logarithmic compression to make large dry-mass allocation ratios more linear-model friendly.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.log1p(`Average dry weight of the root (ADWR)` / (`Average dry weight of vegetative plants (ADWV)` + 0.001)) - 0.30) / (3.86 - 0.30), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "root_minus_shoot_moisture_gap",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Clipped difference between estimated root moisture fraction and vegetative moisture fraction.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "balance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures water-content imbalance as a signed severity measure that can be weighted directly by a linear model.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(((`Average wet weight of the root (AWWR)` - `Average dry weight of the root (ADWR)`) / (`Average wet weight of the root (AWWR)` + 0.001)) - ((`Average wet weight of the growth vegetative (AWWGV)` - `Average dry weight of vegetative plants (ADWV)`) / (`Average wet weight of the growth vegetative (AWWGV)` + 0.001)), -1.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "semantic_vigor_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Numeric agronomy review score from 0.0 to 1.0 judging whether chlorophyll, stature, leaf expansion, and vegetative mass jointly look vigorous for a single row.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a smooth expert-derived growth axis that can align several partially redundant plant-growth signals into one margin dimension.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "semantic_stress_severity_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Numeric semantic severity score from 0.0 to 1.0 assessing combinations of low chlorophyll, weak growth, extreme root-to-shoot allocation, and dry-matter or moisture inconsistency.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous expert severity axis for patterns that may be awkward to express with one simple formula.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
